'''    @classmethod
    def from_contract(cls, profile, fabric):
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        result.name = 'syncwise'
        result.profile = profile
        result.fabric = fabric
        result.nb_node = fabric['n']
        result.sync_interval_ns = fabric['interval_ns']
        result.slice_duration_ns = fabric['slice_ns']
        return result

    def replay(self, guard, trace):
        """Exact packet-level replay (TRACE.md) sharing the compiler model."""
        import exact
        import fab
        model = exact.calib_model(self.profile)
        if not model['feasible']:
            art = exact.calib_artifact(self.profile, model)
            return art
        F = fab.Fab(self.fabric, None, build=False)
        return F.replay(guard, trace, model)''')
